invariants.rationale: The method constructs and returns a HoodieData object, which is expected to be non-null if no error occurred.
The method operates on the provided records, so it is unlikely for tagLocation to be called with null.
The hoodieTable argument is required for tagging locations and should not be null at method exit.
The context is used for operations within the method and is required for execution.
The method explicitly returns an object of type HoodieData.
